newsitem.title: LATVIA: TRASTA SAYS BALTA LISTING "SIGNIFICANT EVENT".
newsitem.headline: TRASTA SAYS BALTA LISTING "SIGNIFICANT EVENT".

text.p: Trasta Bank said on Wednesday that the planned listing of insurance company Balta was a big event for the Latvian market.
Trasta is arranging the launch of Balta on the stock market at a price of 1.75 lats. Its shares will hit the market after the end of the subscription period on August 22.

"The fact that Balta is becoming a public company is a significant event because just now all the companies on the bourse are companies that have been publically privatised," Trasta said in a statement.
It said Balta would be the first company to enter the stock exchange other than via privatisation.
It also said that Balta was the first insurance company to be quoted on the market in the Baltic states.
The company's largest shareholders are New Century Holdings with 34 percent, German Schreiber and Maron Anstalt fur Versicherungsmanagement 21 percent and Zemes Bank with eight percent.
The company made a profit of 423,000 lats in 1996 and took most net premiums in the Latvian market.
